description: Token-endpoint redemption boundaries chained from a fresh authorize step. Redeeming with a wrong client secret yields invalid_client; redeeming the same code twice succeeds once then fails with invalid_grant (single-use); an unsupported grant_type yields unsupported_grant_type. Direct token requests with a missing code, a non-existent code, or no grant_type at all yield the corresponding invalid_request / invalid_grant errors. A multi-redirect client's code redeems successfully when the matching redirect_uri is supplied.
